```{r load-packages}
options(bdat602.source_only = TRUE)
```


## Task 3: Winsorise claim_amount

```{r task3-winsorise}
# TODO: compute p1 and p99 of claim_amount, then create claim_amount_win
p1_claim  <- NULL
p99_claim <- NULL

health_data <- health_data |>
  mutate(claim_amount_win = NULL)  # pmin(pmax(...), ...)

# TODO: verify the new maximum is p99
cat("Original max:", max(health_data$claim_amount, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("Winsorised max:", max(health_data$claim_amount_win, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
```
